verdict.rationale: Each Bot runs on its own cloud computer with a filesystem and terminal, so it can execute code. Its files-and-results docs cover CSV, JSON, source-code files and Jupyter notebooks, and Team Bots are pitched for answering metrics questions from a data warehouse. However, the pack never explicitly documents the assistant writing and running code on user data to produce charts or downloadable outputs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of code-driven data analysis, chart generation, and downloadable result files, plus independent hands-on corroboration of data-analysis use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files
